title: Clarify skill no-leak rules for reading the current installed skill folder
description: Every skill tells agents to read boreal.yaml in this skill folder, then later says not to read .agents or .claude folders unless explicitly scoped. In installed Codex and Claude skills, the skill folder itself is under .agents/skills or .claude/skills, so the wording is internally confusing.
acceptanceCriteria: Skill adapters explicitly allow reading their own SKILL.md, boreal.yaml, and target-specific metadata files.
No-leak rules distinguish the current skill folder from sibling workspace memory, .boreal, .agents, and .claude trees.
workflow-docs tests or skill doctor checks enforce the clarified wording across all generated skills.
closedReason: No-leak wording is clarified across generated and installed skills and covered by workflow-doc tests.
